instance.description: The instance to create the database on.

name.description: A unique identifier for the database, which cannot be changed after the instance is created.

enable_drop_protection.description: Whether drop protection is enabled for this database. Defaults to false.
enable_drop_protection.rationale: Enabling drop protection prevents accidental or unauthorised dropping of the Cloud Spanner database, protecting critical data from being permanently lost.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
